presa.translation: n. [音](如轮唱曲等卡农曲的)声部进入记号

presage.definition: n. a foreboding about what is about to happen
presage.translation:
n. 预感, 预兆, 预知
vt. 预示, 预言
vi. 预感, 预言

presageable.translation: 能预言的, 可预知的

presaged.translation: v. 预示, 预兆( presage的过去式和过去分词 )

presageful.translation: a. 有充分预兆的；预兆的；预感的；=ominous

presagement.definition:
n. The act or art of presaging; a foreboding.
n. That which is presaged, or foretold.

presager.definition:
n. One who, or that which, presages; a foreteller; a
   foreboder.

presages.definition:
n a foreboding about what is about to happen
n a sign of something about to happen
v indicate by signs
presages.translation: v. 预示, 预兆( presage的第三人称单数 )

presaging.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Presage
presaging.translation: v. 预示, 预兆( presage的现在分词 )

presanctified.translation: a. (圣餐面饼、酒等)前次弥撒中祝圣过的
